paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shekalim, chapter 5, mishnah 1, as having been appointed in the Temple over the locking of the gates.[^1]

notes.text: The Torat Emet digital text of Mishnah Shekalim 5:1 explicitly lists Ben Gever over locking the gates. The supplied Temple office and locator are retained without adding other officials, titles, or identity claims from the list.
